entities.name: PMID:10735610
observations: In 80 patients with alcoholic cirrhosis and suspected alcoholic hepatitis undergoing transvenous biopsy, serum laminin at 4.1 UI/ml had 90% sensitivity and 77% specificity for histologically severe alcoholic hepatitis; type IV collagen at 150 ng/ml had 89% sensitivity and 77% specificity. Combining markers did not improve diagnostic value.

entities.name: Serum marker discrimination
observations: In a single cohort of 80 cirrhotic patients with suspected alcoholic hepatitis, biopsy-referenced ROC analysis found laminin 90% sensitive/77% specific and type IV collagen 89% sensitive/77% specific for severe histologic disease at specified cutoffs; external validation was not reported in the abstract.
